notes: PrismRiot in src/PrismRiot.sol is an ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 PRIO with 18 decimals to msg.sender once. It has no administrative role, subsequent minting, transfer tax, or initialization calls. No application contracts are deployed. The pool uses the specified paired ERC-20 currency, a 0.3% fee, and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(economics.initialMarketCapWei / token.totalSupply) * 2^96), expressing paired-currency minor units per PRIO minor unit with PRIO as currency0. The deployer derives the actual opening sqrtPriceX96 from the supplied economics and total supply using the deployed currency address order.
